name: delivery-erp
description: ERP/PDV para Delivery - servidor local, acesso pelo navegador

scripts.dev:mobile: cross-env-shell VITE_HTTPS=true concurrently -n "api,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "pnpm --filter delivery-erp-backend dev" "pnpm --filter delivery-erp-frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter delivery-erp-backend build && pnpm --filter delivery-erp-frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter delivery-erp-backend typecheck && pnpm --filter delivery-erp-frontend typecheck
scripts.init:app: pnpm install && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:seed
